id.description: Globally unique identifier for this scope.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Scope.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Scope" for Scope entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of what this scope includes and excludes.

locations.description: Location identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

groups.description: Group identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

objects.description: Object identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

entities.description: Entity identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

parentScopeId.description: Identifier of a broader parent scope, when this scope is nested inside another scope.

childScopeIds.description: Identifiers of narrower child scopes contained by this scope.

boundaryRules.description: Embedded scope-local rules for inclusion, exclusion, inheritance, or conflict resolution. This is not a referenced entity because boundary logic may be implementation-specific.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this scope record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this scope record was last updated.
